what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the Pond View Commons 40B comprehensive permit hearing to January 11, 2023, by voice vote.
The traffic report review and the naming of a peer review civil engineer were deferred to the next hearing; the engineer has not been retained.
The applicant's attorney wrote that the applicant will not fund peer review until the board decides whether it can override town meeting and water district approval for sewer and water extension.
A neighbor's letter about runoff and icing from the new access road on Howard Street was read into the record; no one spoke in public comment.
The board will ask the applicant to make up the peer review delay, and town counsel is to address the applicant's position.

why_it_matters: The independent review of a 200-unit apartment proposal on Howard Street, covering traffic and civil engineering, cannot start until the applicant funds it, so the timeline of the decision depends on a dispute over the board's authority.
The applicant's position that the board may not override town meeting and water district approval bears on whether sewer and water extension for a 40B project is decided locally or set aside.
